title: SessionKey
description: Outer durable identity. Rust: crates/agentscope-durable/src/types/identity.rs::SessionKey (#[serde(rename_all = camelCase)]). Java: DurableTypes.SessionKey. Both fields are opaque but must be present and bounded by json::text: 1..=256 characters and not blank.

IdentityText.description: 1..=256 characters, and at least one non-whitespace character (json::text rejects blank identities). Length is counted in Unicode code points, which is what Rust's chars().count() and JSON Schema's minLength/maxLength both count.
